decided: With neither the commit setting nor the push setting turned on, each workflow that writes to a change makes one extra read-only check at its end, which reports that committing is off; the workflow then prints nothing and does nothing more.
alternatives: show the commit and push settings in the change's status report, which the end of propose, ff, apply, review and the review walk already reads, so no extra check is made; that would make the status report a third part of orbit this change edits, and archive, which does not read the status report at its end, would still need a check of its own
why: G0 allows workflow text whose effect depends on a setting when, with every setting at its default, what the AI does is unchanged. A read-only check that reports off and leads to nothing changes nothing the user sees or gets, and it is the same kind of addition as one already made: those workflows already read the change's status at their end to decide whether to run the next command.
